DDA< RayT, CoordT, Dim > Class Template Reference
A Digital Differential Analyzer. Unlike HDDA (defined above) this DDA uses a fixed step-size defined by the template parameter Dim! Note The Ray template class is expected to have the following methods: test (time), t0 (), t1 (), invDir (), and operator () (time). See the example Ray class above for their definition.
